pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation
pro_course_detail.description:
This lesson type is for those wishing to improve their ability to naturally speak the English language. This can also include improving your ability to read in English, as well. Conversations will ultimately be based around the goals of the student - there is no single defined structure for every lesson because every student is different. Some students want to have a purely random conversation where the topic can potentially change over time. Other students prefer to focus on a specific topic or have a specific goal in mind (a future interview, job presentation, meeting, etc.). I consider myself to be rather flexible in what I do on iTalki. 

During the lesson, I will be constantly listening to your English and offering corrections, suggestions, or new words and expressions. Many of these will also be typed out. If I notice consistent mistakes or major grammatical errors, additional focus can be placed on correcting those mistakes. I am also open to any questions you may have regarding English (grammar questions, questions about something your read or watched, questions about slang, etc.). 

Ultimately, the goal of these lessons is to improve a student's confidence and comfortability in speaking with a native speaker. Speaking with anyone in a foreign language can be very intimidating at first, but it is my hope that you will feel comfortable and able to speak freely without fear. This is not a judgement zone. 

** PLEASE NOTE that I do NOT teach children. I believe that teaching children requires particular experience. I recommend that you look for one of the many great professional teachers or community tutors on iTalki who have experience teaching children and especially beginners. 

If you are interested in purchasing a package of lessons but have not yet spoken to me, please contact me beforehand so we can discuss your goals and desires for the lesson.

course_info.trial_description:
In our trial lesson we will first get to know each other's background and then get to know your wants and needs and your goals and also your expectations on what you are trying to achieve. 

1. WARMER (Here will will go over basics, basics such as conversations. in these conversations i will be asking you questions, and you will be answering them and you will do the same thing to me as well).

- During this warmer we will build rapport with each other and i will be listening to see how your grammar and pronunciation of words are and also ask you different questions on what you like and dislike and where are you at currently in your English learning journey. 

2. BASIC PRACTICE (Here we will go over a basic understanding of Vowels, Indefinite Articles, Nouns, Pronouns and such other forms of the English language to gauge your knowledge on what you know about them.
-What is your Level of speaking
-What is your level of listening
-what is your level of understanding

All of this is included into our first trial lesson together to see exactly what information that you know currently about the English language.

pro_course_detail.title: Learning English Basics: Getting better with fun conversations
pro_course_detail.description:
1. Beginners: Student will learn the basics of the English Pronunciation System. yes, there is a special way that Americans and People from the U.K. speak and by listening and speaking you to will be able to understand some of the most difficult words spoken colloquially by English speakers from all over the word. Connective speech and etc. So, grab your pen and be ready to listen, repeat and take notes. 

2. Beginners: Student will be practicing words and breaking them down into Syllables, learning vowels and phrases to speak many English words with proficiency.

3. Students will be quizzed on words, Phrases, vowels, and various forms of the English language to see how their progress is going and to move on to higher levels of communication and vocabulary. 

4. Videos, Articles, worksheets, and other various forms of English learning documents will be given to students during class and as homework to continue learning even when they are away from class.

*All students will go through conversations with the Tutor on many different topics and will receive teaching documents and videos to improve every aspect of their English learning experience.

pro_course_detail.title: Business English: From Informal to Formal

1. Student will learn the basics and differences between informal and formal English.

2. Tutor and student will work 1 on 1 mastering the skills needed to speak professionally for the particular job or place that they are interested in going to or working at.

3. Student will take ordinary basic English words and turn them into words of meaning for everyday business conversations and pronouncing them correctly for understanding. 

4. Students' Vocabulary, Grammar, and pronunciation are expected to increase to achieve the level of professionalism for business endeavors.

teacher_info.intro:
Remember your overseas vacation in 1993?

At an amusement park by the sea, you met Barney, a local
resident who had been studying English his entire life.

And yet, when you asked him what his favorite animal was,
he froze. He stammered. He looked up at some trees.

Now why was that?

Indeed, hardly anyone there could speak any English at all.

The next day you went on a train ride. In your compartment
were three backpackers from places you couldn’t pronounce.

Still, they talked to you about camping ... cactus … discos ...
pyramids...fleas...watermelons...bungee jumping...telepathy
UFOs…ponds...off-the-wall jokes . . . all in proper English.

So what was their secret?

Hmmm. Good question.

.
SUMMER VACATION
Remember your vacation at the seaside last summer?

On your third day there, you met some locals at an
amusement park. They told you that they had been studying
English for *ten whole years*.

And yet when you asked them what their favorite animal was, 
they froze. They stammered. They became dumbstruck.

Now, why was that?

Hmmm. Good question.

Indeed, virtually nobody, locals and tourists alike, could
speak any English at all.

THE TRAIN RIDE
At the end of your stay, you decided to return by train. In
your compartment were some travelers who introduced
themselves as being from Kyrgyzstan and Tierra del Fuego . . .
. . . you all had a long, fascinating conversation.

And they spoke *flawless* English.

So what was their secret?

"Oh, I just picked it up," they reply casually.

(In other words they had PRACTICED their English.
 Extensively. Just like in sports).

Righto.

teacher_info.about_teacher:
"Hello! Where's the Lake Town?" Bray asked an 81-year-old
tending some cows. She gave him a puzzled look. "Gee, nobody 
here speaks English," he thought. 

And although Bray had studied the local language at school for
nine years, he had pretty much forgotten everything.

So he kept pedaling along, trying to figure out how to get to the
town, and his accommodation. It was getting dark.

Suddenly, a teenager came into view; he was gathering raspberries, 
cranberries, gooseberries. To Bray's relief — and astonishment — 
the teen was able to give him directions. In perfect English.

“How did you master English?” Bray asked him. 
“Oh, from watching cartoons on TV when I was young,” he answered.
teacher_info.teaching_style:
In class, you will NOT be asked to memorize lines such as 

“I beg your pardon. I was wondering if you could please tell me the price of a third-class, round-trip plane ticket with a student discount for a window-seat in a non-smoking section, departing from Kalamazoo at 3:13 in the morning of Thursday, the 31st of December and arriving in Saskatoon at 11:33 in the evening.” 

Or, “In order to get to the flea market, walk along this boulevard. At the eighth traffic light, you’ll see a subway station to your left. Go down and catch train number 181. After 18 stops, get off. Take the 80 bus down the avenue for eight blocks. Then turn right, walk 88 yards — and you’re there. You CAN’T miss it!"

pro_course_detail.title: English Conversation Practice for Intermediate to Advanced Learners
pro_course_detail.description:
Please Note: I don't offer structured English lessons. Conversation only

My goal is to offer a relaxed conversational setting for students who already have some degree of speaking proficiency, but want to be able to speak more confidently and naturally. I'll want you to speak freely, and I’ll try to make corrections in a way that doesn’t detract too much from the conversation. It's important that you relax and not be afraid to make mistakes, because making mistakes is the best way to improve. We can talk about virtually any topic that interests you, and I can offer you suggestions for making your spoken English more idiomatic and native-sounding.

pro_course_detail.title: German Grammar and Conversation for Self-Learners
pro_course_detail.description:
Please Note: I don't offer structured German lessons for beginners. 

My goal is to help self-study students or those already taking some type of formal instruction.

I especially welcome learners having difficulty with German grammar. When I first started teaching myself, I realized I didn't understand the German grammatical terms and concepts. Then it dawned on me that I didn't really understand them in my native language, English, either. So I had to stop and learn all that before I could go any further. If you, like me, picked up your native language without thinking much about its grammar, I can help you learn what you need to know to understand German grammar.

Of course, understanding German grammar and being able to use it are two different things. If your goal is to speak German spontaneously and correctly, certain concepts and information must be internalized. There are various methods for accomplishing this, and the right way is the one that works best for you. As a self-learner, I tried virtually every resource I could get my hands on, so I can give you lots of suggestions.

In any case, I'll give you the opportunity to speak German as much as possible, either as a means of putting grammatical concepts into practice, or just for the fun of it.
